body:
Continuing S014 (same session, resumed after the connection drop; the write-path claim is released on this trail). Taking the follow-up head B-2026-09-17-1: route memory READS and DELETES through the deterministic path like writes.

Intended change: the classifier already flags is_read/is_delete, so the runtime dispatches on them before the model sees the turn - reads answer from the store's id-bearing listing, deletes apply and confirm from a read-back, both leave the full turn trail. Classifier gates sharpened: a read cue means "the stored facts about me" (not "what do you know about Python"), a delete cue must name a removable fact ("forget that I prefer dark mode" routes; "forget it, let's move on" and "delete that file" do not), and an explicit operation on memory_op wins over re-reading the sentence for cues (the garbled-listing-gets-stored class).

Scope: backend/src/core/agent_runtime.py, backend/src/core/memory_intent.py, backend/src/tools/memory_tool.py, tests/core/test_memory_intent_routing.py (new), tests/core/test_memory_runtime_routing.py (new), tests/core/test_memory_resolution.py (signature tweak), CHANGELOG.md, plus the ledger surface.

Noted: Nia (S015) is live on the connections layer with an explicitly disjoint claim - my scope touches none of her paths. Verification bar applies: live before/after on zai/glm-4.5-flash via the isolated-home harness before "done" is claimed.
